postconditions.expression: all(len(s) == n for n, s in zip(input_values[0], input_values[1]))
postconditions.description: Each string s has length n as specified.

postconditions.expression: all(all(c in '+-' for c in s) for s in input_values[1])
postconditions.description: Each string s consists only of '+' and '-' characters.

postconditions.expression: all(output_values[i] == sum(1 for j in range(n) for k in range(j, n) if is_promising(input_values[1][i][j:k+1])) for i in range(len(input_values[0])))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is the number of promising non-empty substrings of the given string s.
